findings.criterion: A launched worker's time limit keeps recorded headroom over its observed runs, and a limit about to be crossed is reported before an episode fails on it (packages/skeleton/src/entropy-review-protocol.ts:11-16 says both limits sit above the observed run; product 07 §Operator-opened planning pass consumes the review's receipt).
findings.observed: Recorded review durations against ENTROPY_REVIEW_LIMITS.timeoutMs 2,400,000: REVIEW-001 1,019,575 ms (42.5%), REVIEW-002 993,364 (41.4%), REVIEW-003 1,088,847 (45.4%), REVIEW-004 2,215,824 (92.3%). The limit's comment still cites only REVIEW-001's 1,019.6 s. When the deadline is reached the runner raises WorkerFailure('deadline-exceeded') and kills the worker (worker-transport.ts:138-142). A print-mode episode killed this way returns no result envelope, so every finding is lost, but the spend is not (REVIEW-004 cost USD 11.71). The numeric conditions table has no row for entropy-episode duration (0 mentions of 'entropy' in scripts/lib/planning-conditions.mjs). The 2026-09-30 pass recorded the 2,216 s, attributed 384 s of it to one npm test and called the rest unknown, without setting a threshold.
findings.expected: The headroom between the latest review or refutation duration and its timeout is a listed numeric condition, or the limit is re-derived from the four observed runs, so the first signal of a breach is not a timed-out review that leaves no receipt.

resultEnvelope.summary: Census: 4,652 tracked paths from git ls-files; docs/intake/** never read. Four lenses worked serially; two measured findings survived my own refutation attempts. ER5-001: REVIEW-004 used 92.3% of the 2,400 s review timeout (earlier reviews 41-45%). A deadline kills the worker, so the receipt is lost and the spend is not, and no conditions row watches the headroom. ER5-002: two of four deferred register rows with bare order-activation triggers have fired and stay deferred (FUP-0086 on WO-117, FUP-0113 on WO-062), and the harness re-probe row outlived two live Codex dispatches; plan conditions leaves 848 register rows unevaluated. Dropped after probes: an import() blind spot in the read guard (the guard sees it), harness version drift (observedVersion is a minimum), red WO-105 corpus suites (settled by WO-105 D012) and ledger erasures (none on main). Settled or self-reported, so not raised: the cold-start ceiling route, repeated edition blobs, release-table lag and weekly evidence bytes. Two packets. Writes: ignored build output and docs/control/local/ in the copy, scratch under TMPDIR. Awaiting operator disposition.
